purpose: severity assessment (affected leaf area %) for PlantPath AI

lesion.label_source: SAM2 model pseudo-labels (per dataset name/description), not human annotation

leaf.label_source: binary leaf-vs-background masks as published in the dataset

honesty_notes: Validation metrics are computed against the same label source used for training (pseudo-labels for lesion), so they measure fit to that labeler, not agreement with humans.
The disease classifier was not trained, retrained or fine-tuned as part of this work.
